smyx-classroom-engagement-analysis-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of the classroom engagement analysis skill.
- Analyzes real-time student facial expressions and engagement using fixed classroom cameras.
- Computes overall class engagement score (0–100) and identifies low-engagement seat positions (anonymous, no identity stored).
- Generates engagement heatmaps, confusion/low engagement alerts, and teacher suggestions.
- Strong privacy safeguards: no personal data storage or facial recognition; compliant use requires explicit consent.
- Integrates with smart-classroom systems and supports historical report queries via cloud API only.
